text:
zoe: quick note  this morning a handful of CSV-import leads fell to the overflow pool even though SDR capacity was available. looks like enrichment returned after claim expired.

rafa: saw it in traces. enrichment callbacks for hubspot_bulk averaged 35-45s during the window; our claim_ttl for imports is 20s so fallback happened first.

priya: i propose a per-route "late_enrich_reclaim" feature: after claim_expire we keep the lead in a short pending window (e.g., 40s) marked as deferred_candidate. if enrichment returns with a confident owner and SF shows no intervening rep activity, attempt an idempotent reclaim. opt-in per route to avoid impacting realtime flows.

nick: safety checks to add: enrichment.confidence >= 0.65, enrichment.source in ["hubspot_bulk","hs_csv"], SF.owner_last_action_ts < enrichment.timestamp, and reassign_rate_limit_per_user = 3/hour. also cap total auto-reassigns per-route to avoid churn.

zoe: canary plan: enable late_enrich_reclaim on csv-import route for 2% of imports for 12h. metrics: deferred_candidates, reclaim_attempts, reclaim_success, overflow_rate_imports. rollback toggle ready.

rafa: logging events: claim_acquire, claim_expire, deferred_candidate, reclaim_attempt, reclaim_result. include enrichment_version and enrichment_latency in the envelope.

priya: sample config snippet for canary:

```yaml
route: csv-import
claim_ttl_ms: 20000
enrichment_timeout_ms: 30000
fallback_policy: overflow
late_enrich_reclaim:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 40000
  min_confidence: 0.65
  allowed_sources: [hubspot_bulk, hs_csv]
  reassign_rate_limit_per_user_per_hr: 3
```

nick: small implementation note: when enrichment returns after fallback, attempt reclaim only if contact.external_id matches and enrichment.owner != current_owner. check SF.last_activity guard before making changes to avoid stomping active reps. enqueue reclaim ops with backoff and idempotency keys.

hs-webhook-bot: hubspot: enrichment callback contact 00aa1 returned owner after 38s (event evt_5544).

zoe: perfect example candidate. if reclaim enabled that would come back to the original owner instead of overflow.

rafa: ops checklist for rollout:
- deploy canary config (2% imports)
- enable extra claim lifecycle logging and reclaim metrics
- monitor for 6h then 12h; goal: overflow_rate_imports drops by >90% for canary cohort, reclaim_success >95%
- alert and rollback if reclaim_failure_rate > 5% or unexpected reassign spikes

priya: runbook blurb for support: if a rep reports missing lead -> check claim_acquire/expire, deferred_candidate/reclaim logs, enrichment latency and source, SF owner_last_action, then manual reassign steps if auto-reclaim disabled.

nick: i'll open the PR with toggle and migration; default off. will add unit tests around idempotent reassign and owner_last_action guard.

zoe: thanks team  post PR link here and i'll own the dashboard and support notes.

rafa: PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/lead-routing/pull/1011

zoe: starting canary at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. will report back with 3h/12h snapshots. :eyes:
